title: GHCR Publish Cycle: Four Steps
description: Complete publish-and-verify cycle for GHCR: authenticate with PAT, build with registry name, push, verify from clean slate.

steps.description: Step 1: authenticate with CR_PAT environment variable via docker login to ghcr.io.
Step 2: build with full registry name, using docker build -t or docker tag for existing images.
Step 3: push to registry with docker push.
Step 4: verify by removing local copy and pulling as a stranger would to simulate first-time user experience.
